description: Abstract class for XML generator in Zend Framework's XmlRpc component, providing methods for XML element handling, encoding, and output formatting.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Generator_GeneratorAbstract
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface and common functionality for XML generator adapters, including methods for opening/closing XML elements, outputting XML, and managing encoding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the generator with a specified encoding, defaulting to UTF-8, and calls an internal init method.

methods.name: openElement
methods.description: Starts a new XML element with an optional value, returning the object for method chaining.

methods.name: closeElement
methods.description: Closes an XML element, returning the object for method chaining.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Abstract method to output the current XML as a string.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Outputs the XML, resets internal buffers, and returns the XML string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the XML as a string without the XML declaration.

methods.name: stripDeclaration
methods.description: Removes the XML declaration from a given XML string.

methods.name: _openElement
methods.description: Abstract method to start an XML element with a given name.

methods.name: _writeTextData
methods.description: Abstract method to write text data into the current XML element.

methods.name: _closeElement
methods.description: Abstract method to close an XML element with a given name.
